newsitem.title: USA: U S WEST to transfer unit to communications group.
newsitem.headline: U S WEST to transfer unit to communications group.

text.p: U S WEST Inc said Friday it plans to transfer its domestic directory publishing business, U S WEST Dex, from its Media Group to its Communications Group as part of a restructuring in connection with the merger of its domestic wireless interests into AirTouch Communications Inc.

The company put the total value of the transfer at $4.75 billion, with $850 million of the total in shares of U S WEST Communications Group stock to be issued to U S WEST Media Group shareowners and $3.9 billion as an assumption by Communications Group of the Media group's debt.
